name: Chef Nqobi
role: Culinary Artist / Food Filmmaker / Content Creator
bio: Culinary artist and filmmaker from Johannesburg who brings people together through food, music and film. Culinary Director of TastyTing & Taste The Beat — food series dedicated to simplifying recipes creatively. Co-founder of Melodies and Munchies, a multi-artistic event series merging live music with a culinary experience.
highlights: Culinary Director: TastyTing & Taste The Beat food series
Co-founder: Melodies and Munchies (live music x culinary event series)
Trained at Hilton Hotel Sandton & ANEW Hotels (multiple locations)
YouTube channel hosting TastyTing cooking episodes
Known for experimental food curiosity fused with music and film
notable: Melodies and Munchies (music x food event series)

name: DG-TAL Format
bio: One-stop creative hub for all post-production: DIT, Data Wrangling, Offline & Online Editing, Motion Graphics, Graphic Design and final delivery. Clients include Netflix, Showmax, MultiChoice, SABC, Standard Bank, UNICEF, Ballantine's. "DG-TAL Format is Art."
highlights: Netflix SAFTA award: 'The Letter Reader' (2019)
Netflix/Showmax: Love Lives Here, Baby Mamas 2, Mother The Law, Mother To Mother
MultiChoice: Korobela, Wangthembisa, Somathekisi, uShuni Womhlaba
Clients: SABC, Standard Bank, UNICEF, Ballantine's, Prime Video, Telkom, Gallo Music Publishers, Ukhozi FM, Niki's Jazz Restaurant, Tape Gang
Tools: Adobe Suite, DaVinci Resolve, Blender, Cinema 4D, NukeX

name: Fifi Frequency
bio: Refilwe Katong (Fifi Frequency) — female SA broadcaster, voice-over artist and established MC. YFM freelance presenter & digital content producer. Shared stages with Zakes Bantwini, Kamo Mphela, DJ Zintle.
highlights: YFM presenter & digital content producer
UJFM #TheUrbanBrunch (9AM–12PM weekdays)
#UJFMtop30 — Liberty Radio Award nomination
Hosted MusicEx 2024 & Mr & Miss UJ 2024
#ThePlaygroundOnY and #NightsLikeThis on YFM

name: Hāzy
bio: Professional audio engineer offering comprehensive post-production: recording, mixing and mastering across music, podcasts and voiceovers. Multi-booking discounts up to 40%. iTunes Master badge service available.
highlights: 30% off 5+ demo recordings
40% off 5+ final mixes
iTunes Master badge service
Up to 4 revisions per mix & master
Non-refundable 50% deposit to book

name: Kgale
bio: Born Mokgale Puwane (Sep 8 1996), the "Rap-Guitarist of the East." His signature sound blends RnB & hip-hop with ghetto linguistics, delivered live on guitar. Founder of Kgalibarber — a platform for industry grooming and music.
highlights: 5 EPs + production & writing credits; 100K+ streams across platforms (55K+ Apple Music)
Radio: YFM, 5FM, VOW FM, Tuks FM, Welkom FM
MTV Base, Trace TV, Trace Africa video plays
Joburg Theatre, YFM Lyfe Fest, Rand Show, The Wav (Cape Town)
Worked with Fifi Cooper, Just Jabba, Seru, LaCabra, Lowfeye, The Qwellers, Blue Pappi
notable: Mona Lisa ft Sni Mhlongo — 11K+ streams; Trace TV / Trace Africa / MTV Base; 390+ Shazams

name: LuMai
bio: South African singer-songwriter, model and actress with a versatile creative presence across music and visual arts. Active on Apple Music and Deezer; known for collaborations across Afro-pop and R&B-adjacent sounds.
highlights: Active on Apple Music and Deezer as solo artist
Featured vocalist on collaborative tracks across multiple genres
Multi-disciplinary creative: music, modelling, acting

name: OhTeeh
bio: Irresistibly charismatic artist whose voice slides effortlessly between smooth, soulful, and playful. Blends R&B warmth, African soul textures, and contemporary flair — known for bringing heart, humour, and heat to every stage. Artist, Music Producer, Musical Director, DJ and Teacher signed to Velocity Muzik.
highlights: Signed to Velocity Muzik
Multi-role creative: artist, producer, musical director, DJ, teacher
Notable live presence and stage energy
Active on SoundCloud and Audiomack
Live flip: "Please Mr" (Shekhinah) — re-produced & re-arranged

name: Seru The Ellipsis
bio: Born Serupenyana Pharoe. "Ntwana ya Vosloorus, Monna wa Matatiele." Five mixtapes and debut album Leeto (100K+ streams in the first month). Explosive live presence; prolific wordsmith since age 8. Inspired by Khuli Chana, Nasty C and J. Cole.
highlights: 5 mixtapes (Dawn, Rise, Shine, Dusk, Set of Ellipsis) + debut album Leeto — 100K+ streams first month
Viral RedBull 64 Bars freestyle
Radio: 5FM, YFM, Metro FM, Lesedi FM, Umhlobo Wenene FM
Daily Thetha (SABC 1), Channel O; SA Hip Hop Mag, SlikourOnLife, Sportscene
Stage: Cassper, Blxckie, LucasRaps, Reason; Back to City Main Stage 2022; Red Bull B Con Cypher 2023 & 2024; Comic Con 2024
notable: Dawn / Rise / Shine / Dusk / Set of Ellipsis (5 mixtapes)

name: Shivolski
role: Dancer / Content Creator / Social Media Influencer / MC
bio: High-energy MC and dance content creator working at the intersection of hip hop, Amapiano and youth culture. Blends performance, rhythm and crowd psychology to turn hosting into immersive experiences — built in the hip hop scene and expanded into Amapiano spaces. Drawn to curated festivals, brand-led activations and large-scale cultural platforms, with growing international reach across Instagram and TikTok.
highlights: Capitec & Super C brand campaigns
Halls OMFCC ambassador campaign
Global ComLimited football commercial
Dance collaboration with various influencers
Live hosting across festivals & student events — Hipnotik (Swaziland), Qwelfontein, Wav Impact
Mr Bully Tour
notable: Music videos: Speedsta & Zoocci Coke Dope

name: Zolelo Magwaza
bio: Zolelo Magwaza — "Your Most Valuable Digital Asset" (iiam3siixtii). Visual storyteller of Zulu and Tsonga heritage, born in Durban and matured in Johannesburg. Full-spectrum creative across video production, photography, animation and graphic design, working with digital agencies and production houses. Studied Engineering in The Built Environment; his true architecture is visual — framed by light, movement and the intimacy of a captured moment.
highlights: 750+ projects completed, 5,000+ digital assets created, 360+ satisfied clients
Soweto Blaze (Netflix) and NBA Life Season 2 (TV talk show)
Brand SA — 30 Years of Democracy campaign
SANRAL TV commercial (road safety)
Content & collaborations: Play Braam, Banter w Boys, Kent Gush Properties

name: Just Jabba
bio: Njabulo Mpanza, aka Just Jabba — a Johannesburg-born recording artist with seven years building one of South Africa's most distinctive voices, at the intersection of hip-hop, Kwaito and jazz. "Township-raised. World-trained. Untranslatable." Holds a BA Honours in Political Studies (Wits) and a BSocSci in International Relations (UCT), speaks six languages, and has represented South Africa at governance forums in Bangkok, Istanbul, Dubai and New York.
highlights: 150K+ streams as Just Jabba; 130K+ as duo Bougie Pantsula (with Matt Ryan)
Apple Music editorial: A-List South Africa, Mzansi Hits, Mzansi Hip-Hop, Best of the Week
Press: Mail & Guardian, Zkhiphani, Icekream Magazine, Slikour on Life
Brand partnerships: Markham and Red Bull Music
Six languages (isiZulu, English, isiXhosa, Ndebele, Sesotho, Setswana) — Fluent multilingual series
notable: Suitcase Yama Hit (latest project — Apple Music editorial)
Not Too Bad for a Pantsula (EP)
Bougie Pantsula Demo Tape (duo EP with Matt Ryan)
